responsibility: This header declares the gm2 interface to GCC linemaps and diagnostic reporting. It provides prototypes for file/line tracking, creation and querying of location_t values, and formatted error/warning/note/internal-error emission, serving as the C declaration layer for the source-position and reporting adapter implemented in m2linemap.cc.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2linemap group: it declares the native interface to location and diagnostic helpers, while m2linemap.def is the Modula-2 foreign-definition form and m2linemap.cc implements the GCC linemap/diagnostic bridge.
